5223.about: A woman in a red headband stands at a trail map board in a pine forest and raises a finger as if fixing the way in her head, then runs along a dusty forest trail past a large pale boulder, places a stone on a cairn at the top, and finally stands at a viewpoint above a wide green valley holding an open map with a red line drawn on it.

phrases.en: to run along a dusty trail
to point at the marked route

5223.question: What is the woman holding?
5223.answer: She is holding a map with a marked route.

5224.about: A heavy-set king in a gold crown and a crimson fur-trimmed cape sits on a carved wooden throne in a stone castle hall, holding a golden sceptre; servants carry a tray of goblets and food to him past armoured guards. Musicians in doublets sit on the steps below his throne playing lutes and a drum for him. The shot then cuts to a vast cathedral seen from behind the throne, where hundreds of people in medieval dress line the nave and, in the last seconds, all bow low to him at once.

phrases.en: to carry a tray of food

5224.question: What is the crowd doing?
5224.answer: They are bowing to the king.

5225.about: A woman in an orange race vest with a number bib runs along a grey waterfront promenade on a cold overcast day. She takes a white paper cup, drinks from it while still running, then glances down at the watch on her wrist. In the last seconds she comes down the closed-off finishing straight past an orange cone, spectators packed behind metal barriers clapping her in, and crosses the blue finish line with her arms lifted, a second runner far behind her.
5225.question: What is the runner doing?

5226.about: Under the glass-and-iron roof of a station, a man in a beige trench coat with a green duffel bag runs down the platform beside a long dark green train while other travellers walk the other way with suitcases. He reaches an open door in the side of the train, grabs the frame and hauls himself in as it starts to move. The last shot is from the platform looking into the open doorway: he is standing inside the lit interior of the train, holding his bag against his chest and looking back out.
5226.question: What is the man doing?
5226.answer: He is dashing along the platform.

5227.about: A young woman in a neon yellow crop top and shorts jogs towards the camera along a wide paved seafront promenade lined with palm trees, with a beach and blue sea on one side. At first a single black-and-white border collie runs beside her. As she keeps going, more dogs of different breeds and colours appear from both sides and fall in with her, until she is jogging in the middle of a small group of about six dogs, laughing and throwing her arms up.
5227.question: What is the woman doing?
5227.answer: She is jogging with several dogs.

5230.about: A woman in a fur-flapped hat and a burgundy winter coat stands with her arms spread wide in a snowy square in front of a cathedral with coloured onion domes. She is then on a train, holding a glass of black tea in a metal holder and sipping it while snow-covered birch woods slide past the window. Finally she is at an evening winter market strung with fairy lights, smiling as she twists open a small painted wooden doll and holds up the two halves and the smaller doll from inside it.
5230.question: What is the woman opening?
5230.answer: She is opening a little doll.

5231.about: A big family sits along both sides of a long wooden table inside a log house with a lit stove behind them. A tall brass samovar steams in the middle of the table, which is loaded with a platter of dumplings, a stack of pancakes, dark rye bread, jars of pickles, radishes, cucumbers and jam. An elderly woman in a headscarf and apron works the samovar tap, filling glasses of tea and handing them round to the children and adults; at the end everyone reaches in and clinks their glasses together over the food.

phrases.en: to pour a glass of tea
to puff steam from its chimney

5231.question: What is the elderly woman serving?

5232.about: A young woman in an orange sailing jacket and a dark beanie is on the varnished wooden deck of a classic sailing boat crossing a fjord, with a big white sail above her and steep mountains on both sides. She hauls on a rope running through a wooden block, then leans over the side and cranks a metal winch as the boat picks up speed and throws a white wake behind it. She sits back at the rail with a coil of rope in her hands, looks out over the water, and finally punches a fist into the air and shouts while a second crew member steers at the wheel behind her.
5232.question: What is the woman holding?
5232.answer: She is holding a coil of rope.

5233.about: Rows of young officers in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold shoulder cords and shiny buttons stand at attention and hold a salute, with rows of blue and yellow flags on poles behind them. The shot pulls back to a huge parade ground where hundreds of soldiers stand in straight blocks across the tarmac, a single officer in a beret out in front of them, while a crowd of spectators watches from behind steel barriers in the sunshine.
5233.question: What are the spectators doing?
5233.answer: They are watching the military parade.

5234.about: Row after row of young women in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold cords and white gloves stand shoulder to shoulder in a parade square, each row exactly level with the next. They all hold a salute with the white-gloved hand at the cap. The camera moves back over the block of them, showing a packed stand of spectators and a line of national flags on tall poles behind the formation.
5234.question: What are the women in uniform doing?
5234.answer: They are saluting in neat ranks.

5235.about: A woman in a light blue uniform shirt and a peaked cap with a winged badge stands in a container terminal, checking papers on a clipboard that already carry round red marks. She lifts a heavy red stamp over her head and brings it down hard, first on the paperwork and then on the lids of big wooden shipping crates lined up on a rack, watched by dockworkers in hi-vis vests. The shot then runs down a long aisle between walls of stacked shipping containers, with gantry cranes lowering their spreaders overhead and a forklift parked among more crates, and ends with her standing alone in the middle of the aisle.
5235.question: What is the woman doing?
5235.answer: She is stamping the wooden cargo crates.

5237.about: A short travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and a checked headscarf sprints up the crest of a red dune at dusk, then stands at a sandstone cliff face and touches carved figures and inscriptions cut into the rock. The clip ends at night by a campfire in the desert, under a sky thick with stars, where someone pours tea from a brass pot into his small cup and he lifts it towards the camera.
5237.question: What is the man holding?
5237.answer: He is holding a small cup of tea.

5238.about: A selfie-style travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and checked headscarf holds the camera at arm's length on a red dune with the sun setting behind him, laughing and turning. He then stands at a sandstone cliff and runs his hand over huge human figures carved out of the rock, tilting his head back to see the top of them. At night he sits by a campfire under a starry sky while tea is poured into his cup, and he holds the cup up smiling.
5238.question: What is he doing at the cliff?
5238.answer: He is stroking the carved stone.

5240.about: A falconry clip in the desert at dusk. A young man in a white thobe and a red-checked headscarf swings a lure on a long cord over his head. A falcon flies in low across the sand, beats its wings and drops onto his raised gloved fist, spreading both wings wide as it settles. He laughs, then feeds it small pieces of meat from his fingers. Friends and a pickup truck stand behind him, and camp tents sit among the dunes.

phrases.en: to feed meat to the falcon

5240.question: What is the falconer doing?
5240.answer: He is feeding meat to the falcon.

5242.about: A woman in a silky champagne slip dress with a matching long satin robe stands at an open window in a Paris apartment. She sprays perfume onto her wrist, rubs her wrists together and sprays her neck, then walks slowly through the perfume mist, flicks her hair back and turns to the camera smiling. A table beside her is crowded with perfume bottles, and Paris rooftops are visible through the window.
5242.question: What is the woman walking through?
5242.answer: She is walking through the perfume mist.

5243.about: A woman in a beige blazer works at a huge blank month calendar drawn on a white office wall. She writes in a tabbed spiral notebook on the desk, then presses coloured sticky notes into the empty date squares one after another until the whole month is covered in pink, orange, green and blue notes, and steps back to look at the finished plan.
5243.question: What is the woman covering with notes?
5243.answer: She is covering the calendar with sticky notes.

5244.about: Two teenage boys in navy school hoodies meet in a school corridor lined with coloured lockers and do a clasped-hand shake, laughing. Outside they sit on a wooden bench with their backpacks open, unwrapping a sandwich and holding a red apple while they talk. The shot then widens to the school field, where a crowd of students in the same navy uniform play football on the grass in front of the school building.

phrases.en: to hold up a red apple

5244.question: What is the blond boy holding?
5244.answer: He is holding a red apple.

5246.about: A young woman in a white lab coat, white cap and safety goggles works in a busy laboratory. She pipettes bright blue liquid into a rack of test tubes, swirls a conical glass flask of blue-green liquid over a hotplate, then holds the flask up to the light and smiles at it. She bends to a microscope with a flask of blue liquid beside her, and at the end holds up a flask of glowing pink liquid while a colleague at the next bench watches.

phrases.target: the man in the blue shirt

5246.question: What is the woman peering through?
5246.answer: She is peering through a microscope.

5247.about: A trail of big muddy footprints runs the whole length of a white tiled hallway. A small elderly woman in an apron stands at one end holding a mop and wags her finger at a large young man in a black T-shirt who is holding a motorcycle helmet; his boots and his dog are both caked in mud. She hands him the mop, he lowers his head and takes it, and starts pushing it over the prints while the dog sits and watches.

phrases.en: to sit obediently by the wall

5247.question: What is the young man doing?
5247.answer: He is mopping the muddy footprints.

5248.about: A young woman in a coral jacket rides a stand-up electric scooter along a sunlit seaside promenade, grinning at the camera with the blue sea and a stone breakwater behind her. She then stands beside a long rank of parked rental e-scooters at the water's edge, tapping her phone; a close-up over her shoulder shows the rental app open on the screen with a circular logo and a blue button. Finally a wide shot shows a palm-lined promenade with a dozen people riding hired e-scooters past the trees.

phrases.target: the woman in the orange jacket

phrases.en: to ride next to the sea
phrases.target: the woman in the orange jacket

phrases.en: to stand in a long row

5248.question: What is the woman looking at?
5248.answer: She is looking at her phone.

5249.about: A young man in a grey sweatshirt and mint-green rubber gloves stands at a kitchen sink and works on a blackened cast-iron frying pan, rubbing it hard with a soapy steel-wool pad until foam covers it. He lifts a heavy sooty pot out of the sink and scours its round underside, grimacing with the effort. He then hauls a cast-iron grill pan with a ridged rack out of the water, sets it over the sink and scours the black bars of the rack with both hands, foam and grime running off into the basin.
5249.question: What is the man doing?
5249.answer: He is washing a dirty pan.

5251.about: An older woman with short white hair and red glasses sits behind a curved wooden reception counter in a busy open-plan office. She holds a corded telephone handset to her ear with one hand while her other hand moves over the keys of a keyboard on the counter in front of her. She then leans over an open ring notebook and writes in it with a pencil, still on the phone, and presses a rubber stamp down onto a sheet of paper. At the end she laughs and raises her hand to greet someone off camera. Behind her, colleagues work at desks with monitors and rows of files.
5251.question: What is the woman doing?
5251.answer: She is talking on the phone.

5252.about: A street fruit seller in a conical straw hat stands behind an enormous pyramid of yellow and green mangoes stacked on her stall on a hot Vietnamese street, with scooters and shophouses passing behind her. A brass pan balance hangs on chains beside the fruit. She smiles, takes a mango, and holds open a brown paper bag; a close-up shows hands dropping spiky red rambutans into the bag over a bed of more rambutans and mangoes. A wide shot shows the whole mango pyramid with a pineapple perched on top under a blue awning. At the end she laughs happily and reaches across the wooden counter to hand the bag over.
5252.question: What is the street seller doing?

5253.about: In a sunny green park, an old man with white hair, a flat cap and a beige suit strides and bounces along the path with his arms swinging, laughing at the camera. A grey-haired man in a cycling jersey pedals a bicycle along the same tree-lined path. Then a group of about ten white-haired women and men in summer dresses and light clothes stand spread out on a paved square doing a dance-exercise class together, arms stretched out to the side, all moving in time under the trees.
5253.question: What are the old people doing?
5253.answer: They are dancing under the trees.

5254.about: In a green park an old man in a flat cap and tweed jacket dances along a path with his fists up, beaming. An old woman with white hair in a lilac cardigan leans down over a bed of bright orange marigolds and looks at them closely while a cyclist rides past behind her. Then several elderly couples dance together on a wide paved terrace under a blue sky with white clouds: one white-haired man holds his wife by the hand and waist and turns her, and the pair in the foreground hold each other by the shoulders, laughing into each other's faces as they dance.
5254.question: What are the old people doing?
5254.answer: They are dancing with their partners.

5255.about: A courtroom. An elderly judge in a red robe and white wig sits at a high wooden bench and reads a document aloud. A young man in a dark suit stands in the dock below her and stares up, shaken, as she speaks. She lifts a wooden gavel and strikes it on its block. A wide shot shows the packed court, barristers in wigs and gowns at their tables and a full public gallery.
5255.question: What is the young man doing?
5255.answer: He is staring up at the judge.

5256.about: A large wood-panelled hall of a court. A judge in a red robe and white wig stands at a raised lectern and speaks to the room from written notes. Five more judges in wigs and black gowns sit in a row behind him. In front of him a packed hall of seated people listens; a man at a table in the front row stands up while the judge is still speaking.
5256.question: What is the judge in red doing?

5258.about: A rooftop bar at sunset. A laughing young woman in a bright patterned shirt stands behind a long counter and shakes a metal cocktail shaker beside her ear. A whole row of people along the counter shakes shakers with her in the same rhythm. Strings of light bulbs hang overhead, the sea and a pink sky are behind them, and glasses, juice bottles and steel tins stand on the counter.
5258.question: What is the woman doing?
5258.answer: She is making drinks at the bar.

5259.about: A wooden jetty on a mountain lake. A woman with pink hair holds a paper coffee cup and leans on the boards next to a small brown dachshund, her mouth open in surprise. A very large white mountain dog, soaked from the water, steps onto the jetty and shakes the water out of its thick white coat, the hair standing out in all directions. The woman laughs and covers her mouth while a bearded man behind her strokes the dog.

phrases.en: to shake its thick white fur
to scurry across the wet boards

5259.question: What is the big white dog doing?
5259.answer: It is shaking its thick white fur.

5260.about: A kitchen. A young man in a grey T-shirt sits at a counter and shovels a slice of strawberry cream cake into his mouth with a fork, cream smeared on his lips. A young woman in a purple cardigan appears in the doorway behind him and stands with her arms folded, staring at him. He freezes mid-bite, looks at her wide-eyed, pushes the plate away and finally hangs his head and hides his mouth behind his hand.

phrases.en: to hang his head in shame

5260.question: What is the woman doing?
5260.answer: She is standing with folded arms.

5261.about: A picnic on the grass by the beach. A woman with pink hair opens a pizza box on her lap, lifts out a slice with the cheese stretching, and holds it out to the friends sitting around her. A jogger stops and takes a piece, and an older woman walking two dogs is offered one as well. In a wide shot the whole group sits on blankets in a circle, each of them eating their own slice while the open box stands in the middle.

phrases.en: to share her pizza with everyone
to walk two dogs on leads

5261.question: What is the pink-haired woman doing?
5261.answer: She is sharing her pizza with everyone.

5263.about: A woman films herself putting up and styling a set of floating oak shelves on a white wall. She runs her hand along a bare shelf, then stacks colourful hardback books in piles on the boards, stands a framed family photo in front of them, and sets a pale ceramic vase and a trailing pothos plant on the shelves. At the end she steps back and looks up at the finished wall of shelves full of books, frames and plants.

phrases.en: to put books on a shelf

5263.question: What is the woman doing?
5263.answer: She is putting books on a shelf.

5264.about: In a sunlit flat with a mustard-yellow sofa and many houseplants, a woman rearranges the living room. She pulls the sofa across the parquet floor into a new position, kneels to push the oval coffee table onto the rug and straightens the books and vase on it, then lifts a large abstract canvas onto the wall above a wooden shelf unit. The last shot is filmed from the doorway: she sits down on the sofa and spreads her arms out along its back.

phrases.en: to stretch out on the sofa

5264.question: What is the woman doing first?
5264.answer: She is shifting the sofa across the floor.

5265.about: A young man with a camera round his neck stands on a wooden jetty in a container port. A small motorboat passes behind him while gantry cranes and stacks of steel shipping containers fill the far bank. He raises a pair of binoculars and watches a green ship loaded with containers glide past, then the white bow of an enormous cruise ship slides in right beside the jetty and he tips his head further and further back, open-mouthed, as its decks pass above him.

phrases.en: to look up at the ship

5265.question: What is the young man doing?
5265.answer: He is looking through his binoculars.

5267.about: At a biathlon shooting range, a female athlete in a turquoise race suit lies prone on a mat in the snow with her rifle resting on its stand. She sights along the barrel at a row of five round metal targets set out across the snow, works the bolt and fires. Officials and other athletes stand behind her by the fencing, and at the end she pushes herself up off the mat, smiling.
5267.question: What is the woman doing?
5267.answer: She is shooting at the targets.

5268.about: A wide view of a biathlon range in flat winter light with a crowd of spectators packed behind the barriers. A female athlete in a green and blue race suit lies prone on a mat, the butt of her long rifle in her shoulder and her cheek against the stock, and shoots at five black targets set out on the snow in front of her. She holds the position through several shots, then lifts her head off the rifle and grins.
5268.question: What is the athlete aiming at?
5268.answer: She is aiming her rifle at the targets.

5269.about: A young woman in a beige coat and orange beret shops her way through a city: first in a wood-panelled chocolate shop where she holds up a chocolate bar, then at a clothes rail where she takes down an olive coat, then at the till where she hands the coat over and pays at the card terminal, then walking through the glass atrium of a shopping centre, and finally out through the doors holding a large white gift bag tied with a gold ribbon.
5269.question: What is the woman doing?
5269.answer: She is purchasing an olive jacket.

5270.about: A young woman in a supermarket aisle grabs cereal boxes off the shelves and throws them into her trolley as she pushes it down the aisle. The pile in the trolley grows shot by shot until, at the checkout, she stands beside a trolley stacked with a tower of cereal boxes far above her head.
5270.question: What is the young woman doing?
5270.answer: She is shopping in a supermarket.

5271.about: Three hikers with big backpacks stand at a wooden railing on the rim of the Grand Canyon under a clear blue sky. One after another they cup their hands round their mouths and yell out over the canyon with their mouths wide open, then all three yell together with their arms flung out towards the drop.
5271.question: What are the three people doing?
5271.answer: They are shouting with their arms out.

5274.about: A young man in a grey vest stands at the door of a yellow-and-turquoise tiled shower and turns the tap. Water pours from the shower head; he holds his hand under the stream to test the temperature and pulls it back. Then he is under the shower himself, bare-chested and drenched, water running down his face and body as he works shampoo into his hair.
5274.question: What is the young man doing?
5274.answer: He is lathering his soaked hair.

5276.about: Two young sisters chase each other around the sofa of a bright living room. They then drape a big white blanket over the dining chairs to build a den and grin out at the camera from the gap underneath. Next they face each other across a kitchen counter, snarling over a single chocolate-chip cookie on a paper plate, and finally each of them bites into her own cookie, laughing at the camera above the empty plate.

phrases.en: to rest on the granite counter

5276.question: What are the siblings sharing?
5276.answer: The siblings are sharing a chocolate-chip cookie.

5277.about: A boy and a girl run through a living room, then whisper and laugh together under a white sheet stretched into a den. At a table they both grip the same chocolate-chip cookie and pull, faces screwed up, until it breaks into two halves and each keeps one. The clip ends in a sunny back garden where a big group of children run across the grass and then flop down in one laughing pile.
5277.question: Where are the children lying?
5277.answer: The children are lying on the grass.

5278.about: A young man in a denim jacket with orange headphones round his neck walks along a city pavement past parked cars while a cyclist rides by. He reaches the corner where two streets cross, marked by a fire hydrant and chalk drawings on the paving, then steps out over the striped crossing into the middle of the busy junction, passing other pedestrians before walking on past cafe tables under red umbrellas.

phrases.en: to wear headphones round his neck

5278.question: What is the young man doing?
5278.answer: He is strolling past chalk drawings.

5279.about: A man in a dark suit sits at a polished wooden desk in a grand hall with EU and French flags behind him and writes a looping signature on a sheet of paper with a gold fountain pen. He works through a tall stack of pages, lifting each one as he signs. Then two aides unroll an enormous roll of paper the whole length of the table, and while photographers film he leans over it and signs it with an oversized pen.
5279.question: What is the young man signing?
5279.answer: He is signing a giant scroll.

5280.about: A woman in a green fleece stands on a country lane beside a weathered wooden post whose two arms read VILLAGE and LAKE, and she touches one arm as she reads it. Next she stands in a town square under a tall metal post covered in arms pointing to MUSEUMS, HARBOUR and OLD BRIDGE, looking up at them. Finally the same kind of post stands on a grassy clifftop above the sea and she throws both arms up beside it, holding a water bottle.

phrases.en: to gaze up at the signs

5280.question: What is the woman doing?
5280.answer: She is throwing both arms up.

5283.about: A woman in a bright patchwork shirt and headwrap lowers a huge column of colourful plates into a steel kitchen sink, adding more plates to the top of the stack. Water pours over the tall pile and white foam runs down its sides. She rinses the plates one by one and slots them into the draining rack, and the camera ends on the empty gleaming sink and its drain as she smiles down at it.
5283.question: What is the woman doing?

5286.about: Two young women in a bedroom hung with fairy lights play tug-of-war over a lilac hooded sweatshirt, both laughing. They then bunch it up between them and pull faces at a phone held out at arm's length for a selfie. In the last third they sit on the bed and one plaits the other's hair while she gives a thumbs-up.
5286.question: What is the red-haired girl doing?
5286.answer: She is doing her friend's hair.

5287.about: Two teenagers in a bedroom hold up a sparkly silver top and laugh, then lean into the camera and blow a kiss. One sits behind the other on the bed and plaits her hair. The clip cuts to a living room where about fifteen girls are packed onto a sofa and the floor, all shouting and laughing at the camera at the same time.
5287.question: What is the brown-haired girl doing?
5287.answer: She is doing her friend's hair.

5290.about: A young woman in a beige trench coat with long braids walks along a palm-lined street in a hot, sunny Gulf city, tipping her head back to look up. Behind her rises a huge curved glass residential tower, and the clip ends on a slow tilt up the mirrored flanks of an enormous spire-topped skyscraper against the blue sky.

phrases.en: to rise into the blue sky

5290.question: What is the woman gazing up at?
5290.answer: She is gazing up at a huge skyscraper.

5291.about: Inside a full airliner cabin. A blonde woman sleeps slumped against the window with her mouth open, then the shot pans back through the rows: a bearded man in a suit sleeps with a grey neck pillow, a man in a hoodie sleeps behind him, and further back rows of men in suits and jackets doze in their seats down the length of the dim cabin.

phrases.en: to sleep with her mouth open
to sleep with his hood up

5291.question: What is the blonde woman doing?
5291.answer: She is sleeping with her mouth open.

5292.about: A montage of people falling asleep where they should be awake: a young man at a computer in an open-plan office yawns hugely, then drops face down onto his keyboard; a student in a grey hoodie and glasses sleeps on an open book in a library; a man in a jacket sits slumped back on a park bench in bright sunshine with his head tipped back, asleep; a man in a grey tracksuit sprawls yawning on a sofa beside a coffee table holding a twin-bell alarm clock and a phone.

phrases.en: to drool on an open book

5292.question: What is the office worker doing?
5292.answer: He is dozing off at his desk.

5293.about: Baseball action in a sunlit stadium: a runner in a white uniform slides feet first through the dirt towards the plate in a cloud of dust; an infielder in a colourful cap crouches low with a leather mitt on his hand as the umpire watches; the runner dives full length head first and reaches the base; the fielder scoops the ball into his glove; a final dive sends dust flying across the base line.
5293.question: What is the runner doing?
5293.answer: He is sliding in the dirt.

5294.about: A woman in checked pyjamas and a beige cardigan stands barefoot on a cold tiled hallway floor, hopping from foot to foot and hugging herself, shivering. A close-up shows her feet stepping into a pair of white fluffy sheep-face slippers on the wooden floor. She then walks comfortably down the hallway towards the camera in the slippers, relaxed and smiling.
5294.question: What is the woman doing?
5294.answer: She is walking in her slippers.

5296.about: Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.

phrases.en: to stir with a wooden spoon
to hold a piece of cheese
to boil in a big pot

5296.question: What is the young man doing?
5296.answer: He is cooking a traditional dish.

5297.about: A woman with a backpack walks up a cobbled path to a hilltop castle that has fallen apart - roofless stone shells, broken walls and empty window holes standing against a sunrise. She stops among the broken walls and throws both arms open. The clip then cuts to her at a railing above a mountain lake, and finally to her leaning over the side of a wooden boat drifting through a narrow gorge, trailing her hand in the turquoise water.

phrases.en: to walk up a cobbled path

5297.question: Where is the woman walking?
5297.answer: She is walking towards an old ruin.

5298.about: A young woman in a beige tailored jacket over a white top stands at a perfume counter in a brightly lit shop. She holds a paper test strip to her nose, then lifts a glass bottle and sniffs it, closes her eyes, waves the scent toward her face with her hand and reaches for another bottle on the display.
5298.question: What is the woman doing?
5298.answer: She is testing perfumes in a shop.

5299.about: An elderly woman in a headscarf pushes a checked suitcase onto the belt at an airport checkpoint while a long queue waits behind her. An officer in uniform opens the case and it is packed with sausages, cheese and jars of pickles - none of it allowed through. On the scanner monitor the outline of a chicken leg shows up inside the bag. The officer holds the case open and speaks to her while she clutches a jar and looks up at him.
5299.question: What is the old woman holding?
5299.answer: She is holding a glass jar.

5301.about: A young woman in a yellow dress stands in a huge summer meadow full of yellow, white and blue wildflowers. She sneezes hard into her cupped hands, screws her eyes shut, wipes under her nose and presses a hand to her chest with a miserable, streaming-eyed face while the pollen-heavy field goes on around her and other people wander through the flowers in the background.
5301.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?
5301.answer: She is sneezing into her hands.

5302.about: A young man in an orange jacket sits on a park bench directly under a cherry tree covered in pale pink flowers. He tips his head back, mouth wide open, and sneezes so hard that the tissues beside him fly up into the air. Petals and bare blossom branches fill the frame behind him. He then leans forward, pinches his nose and wipes it, with used tissues and a coffee cup on the bench next to him.
5302.question: What is the young man doing?
5302.answer: He is sneezing beneath a blossoming tree.

5303.about: A woman in a yellow coat, striped knitted hat, scarf and mittens stands in a snowy city square in front of a white church with golden domes. She holds out a dark mitten flat in front of her and lets the falling snow land on it, leaning in to look closely at the single white crystals caught on the wool, laughing as more come down around her. At the end she turns away and walks off across the snow-covered square.
5303.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?
5303.answer: She is catching snowflakes on her hand.

5304.about: A woman in a bright tiled kitchen holds both palms up to the camera, pulling a disgusted face: her hands and fingers are covered in thick dark brown grime. She steps to the white sink, turns on the tap and rubs a bar of purple soap over one filthy palm until white foam builds up. She scrubs the foam between her hands, then rinses both hands under the running water while dark specks wash into the basin. At the end she holds up the bar of soap in one hand and a completely clean pink palm in the other, smiling.

phrases.en: to pour water into the basin

5304.question: What is the woman doing?
5304.answer: She is scrubbing the dirt from her hands.

5306.about: A man in a denim shirt is slouched deep into a brown armchair in a carpeted room, knees up and socked feet resting on the seat, talking to someone off camera. The shot cuts to a living room where he sits sunk into a patterned sofa beside a woman while a small boy leans against them. The room then fills: more and more people arrive and drop onto the sofas, sprawling across the cushions and each other, laughing, until the whole sectional is packed with a dozen or more friends lying back with their legs stretched out over the arms and over one another.

phrases.en: to sit in a brown armchair
phrases.target: the man in the denim shirt

phrases.en: to sit on the woman's lap

phrases.target: the man in the grey T-shirt

5306.question: What is the little boy doing?
5306.answer: He is sitting on the woman's lap.

5307.about: A man in a denim shirt sits alone in a grey armchair in a bright open-plan home, drinking from a white mug. He leans back on a colourful patchwork sofa and stretches both arms out along the backrest, taking up the whole seat. The shot then opens onto a very large, almost empty living room with a huge grey sectional sofa running around three sides of the floor, the man sitting by himself in the middle of it with a wall-mounted television behind him. People run in from both sides and throw themselves onto the sectional, kicking their legs up and cheering, and by the end a dozen friends are spread out around the whole sofa with room to spare, waving at the camera.

phrases.en: to sip from a white mug
phrases.target: the man in the denim shirt

phrases.en: to lean against a teal cushion
phrases.target: the man in the red T-shirt

5307.question: Where are all the people sitting?
5307.answer: They are sitting on a spacious sectional sofa.

5308.about: A young woman in a cream cardigan sits at a kitchen table biting into a chocolate-chip cookie, a plate of more cookies in front of her and fairy lights strung on the wall behind. Something makes her look up; she gets up, still holding the cookie, and pads down the hallway to the front door in slippers. She presses her face to the peephole and squints through it. She opens the door and a delivery man in an orange high-visibility jacket and helmet is standing there holding an enormous bunch of sunflowers — big round yellow heads on long green stems. Her mouth falls open in delight and she takes the bunch in both arms.
5308.question: What is the man holding?

5309.about: A woman in a grey blazer and glasses sits at her desk in a large open-plan office and looks down in surprise: a takeaway coffee cup and a wrapped pastry have appeared next to her keyboard. She picks up a small white card propped against them and holds it up — a smiley face is drawn on it in pen. She looks around over the top of her monitor at the rows of cubicles where her colleagues are working, then stands holding the coffee, scanning the room to work out who left it. She ends up back at her desk with the cup in both hands, smiling.

phrases.en: to look at a small note

5309.question: What is the woman looking at?
5309.answer: She is looking at a small note.

5311.about: A young woman sits in a warm living room strung with fairy lights, crying and rubbing the back of her neck. A friend drapes a thick knitted blanket over her shoulders, others lean in, hold her hands and put their arms around her. By the end the whole group is lying together under blankets on the sofa, quiet, still and smiling.

phrases.en: to doze under a chunky blanket
to wear a pale blue hoodie

5311.question: What are the friends doing?
5311.answer: They are snuggling under cosy blankets.

5312.about: In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.

phrases.target: the man in the black T-shirt

5312.question: What is the man in green doing?
5312.answer: He is grilling a coiled sausage.

5313.about: A young woman in a pink and mint traditional Korean dress spins in front of a tiled palace gate in daylight. She then sits at a night street-food market strung with paper lanterns, eating an orange rice cake from a paper cup and pulling a wide-eyed face at the taste. The last shot is a night city crossing where whole building fronts are covered in glowing electric signs in red, blue and yellow; a bus passes behind her while she makes a small finger heart.

phrases.en: to twirl in a flowing dress
to bite into a rice cake

5313.question: What is the woman eating?
5313.answer: She is eating a rice cake on a skewer.

5314.about: A young woman with a camera round her neck browses a souvenir stall on a Paris riverside. She picks up a small metal Eiffel Tower, then lifts a snow globe with a tower inside and looks at it up close. In the last shots she holds a large woven straw basket with two round handles, loaded with metal towers, fridge magnets and postcards, while an older woman behind the stall puts a red beret on her head.
5314.question: What is the young woman carrying?
5314.answer: She is carrying a big basket.

5315.about: A young woman stands in a souvenir kiosk hung with racks of picture cards, holding up a small metal Eiffel Tower keychain while the smiling stallholder watches. She holds a snow globe up against the sky by the river, then tries on a red and a navy beret in front of a mirror. At the end she carries two straw baskets and a thick fan of picture cards showing Paris landmarks, spreading them out towards the camera.

phrases.en: to try on a red hat

5315.question: What is the woman holding?

5316.about: A young woman in a red dress with a backpack twirls under tiled arches beside a fountain. She then sits close to the camera at a bar counter with a glass of red wine, a plate of thin cured ham and a dish of fried potatoes; her thick dark hair grows in tight rings and springs around her face as she leans in, laughs and drinks. The clip ends on a mosaic rooftop terrace at sunset with her arms thrown open over the city.
5316.question: What is the woman drinking?
5316.answer: She is sipping a glass of red wine.

5317.about: On a wooden stage at dusk, under a web of small hanging bulbs, a flamenco dancer performs in a black dress whose skirt is built from tier after tier of folded red and black frills. A guitarist plays seated at the side and two women watch and clap. As she turns and stamps, the layered frills lift and swirl out around her legs, filling most of the frame.
5317.question: What is the dancer doing?
5317.answer: She is swirling her ruffled skirt.

5318.about: A young woman in a red blazer stands on a low wooden platform in a European city square and speaks into a microphone on a stand. A crowd presses around her, many of them filming with their phones. She gestures with one arm while she talks, then raises her fist and the crowd claps.
5318.question: What is the woman doing?
5318.answer: She is speaking into a microphone.

5320.about: In a bright clinic a physiotherapist holds up a model of the human spine and shows it to a young man in a grey T-shirt, moving her finger along the vertebrae. She then points at his lower back, has him raise his arms and stretch, and he turns to the camera smiling.
5320.question: What is the woman showing the man?
5320.answer: She is showing him a spine model.

5321.about: A figure skater in a navy outfit glides across an ice rink with one leg stretched out behind him, pulls his arms in to his chest and spins fast on one skate, then slows, straightens up and glides away across the ice.
5321.question: What is the skater doing?
5321.answer: He is turning round and round.

5322.about: A man in a dark red T-shirt sits at a kitchen counter and tastes a bowl of green soup. He pulls a face and sticks his tongue out, gulps water from a glass, wipes his mouth with a napkin, drinks from a white mug, and finally spits the soup out of his mouth over the counter.
5322.question: What is the man doing?
5322.answer: He is spitting liquid over the counter.

5323.about: Two children sit on a wooden jetty at a turquoise mountain lake. A man picks up a large grey stone lying on the boards, carries it to the edge with both hands and hurls it into the water, throwing up a huge white splash. He then jumps in himself and surfaces in the lake.
5323.question: What is the man throwing?
5323.answer: He is throwing a big stone.

5324.about: A young woman stands at a kitchen sink and squeezes a white drop of dish soap from a blue-capped bottle onto a yellow-and-green sponge she holds over a large steel pan crusted with red tomato sauce. She scrubs the inside of the pan with the sponge under the running tap until foam covers the surface and the sauce washes away. She rinses the pan, then turns to the camera holding the clean, shining pan in one hand and the sponge in the other.
5324.question: What is the woman doing?
5324.answer: She is washing a pan with a sponge.

5326.about: In a gymnastics hall with a vaulting horse, a balance beam and blue landing mats, a young gymnast in training kit lands badly and sits down on the mat with her face screwed up in pain, clutching her bare foot. An older woman in a grey training shirt kneels beside her, takes the foot in her hands and winds a beige elastic bandage around the ankle, fastening it with tape. When the ankle is strapped the woman puts an arm around the gymnast's shoulders and holds her while she cries.
5326.question: What is the coach doing?
5326.answer: She is putting on a bandage.

5327.about: In a brightly painted hair salon a client sits in the styling chair with a black sleeveless salon cape fastened at her neck and hanging over her shoulders and arms down to her lap. The stylist stands behind her and sprays a can of hairspray over the client's large curled updo, holding a comb in the other hand; a cloud of spray drifts over the hair. At the end the camera holds on the finished updo and the black cape covering the seated client's back.
5327.question: What is the stylist doing?
5327.answer: She is spraying the updo with hairspray.

5328.about: A young woman in a walk-in wardrobe lifts a loose peach-coloured women's shirt with ruffles down the front off the rail and holds it up in front of her, sniffing it and smiling. She sprays it with a small glass atomiser, then takes a large white spray bottle and mists the whole rail of hanging clothes, walking along the rack from the pale shirts to the bright dresses. At the end she stands back in the middle of the wardrobe, phone in hand, looking pleased at the rows of clothes.

phrases.en: to spray perfume on her wrist

5328.question: What is the woman doing?

5329.about: A man's open palm fills the frame holding one small pale seed that has split open, with a white root curling out of it and two tiny green leaves. He crouches over a black seed tray of soil blocks where the same seeds have pushed up as bent green shoots, laughing and pointing at one of them with his finger. The shot pulls back to show him standing behind the tray of seedlings with a large green field stretching to the horizon behind him at dusk.
5329.question: What is the man holding?
5329.answer: He is holding a tiny seed.

5330.about: At a Paris pavement cafe a man in a beige trench coat, straw hat and dark sunglasses sits at a small round table behind a wide-open newspaper with a cup of coffee in front of him. A long black camera lens pushes through a torn hole in the middle of the newspaper and points down the street; he leans out from behind a lamppost to take another photograph, then hides the camera behind the paper again. A waiter in a waistcoat and tie walks up behind him and stands watching over his shoulder.
5330.question: What is the spy doing?
5330.answer: He is hiding behind a newspaper.

5331.about: A very muscular young woman stands at a thatched beach bar in front of a big glass jug on a wooden table. She squeezes an orange in her bare hands until the juice runs into the jug, then picks up a whole watermelon and crushes it between her hands until it bursts and its juice pours into the jug. At the end she turns to the camera and flexes her bicep while the guests behind her laugh and cheer with their drinks.
5331.question: What is the strong woman crushing?
5331.answer: She is crushing a watermelon with her bare hands.

5332.about: Inside a busy restaurant a waitress takes plates of food from the kitchen pass while a chef in whites hands them over. Waiters in white shirts and dark aprons carry stacked plates through the dining room between white-clothed tables, and a waitress sets a cappuccino down on the bar counter in front of a guest. At the end the whole team - waiters, waitresses, the chef and the manager - crowd together in front of the open kitchen with their arms round each other, shouting and laughing into the camera as one group.

phrases.en: to pour water into a glass

5332.question: What is the grey-haired man doing?
5332.answer: He is pouring water into a glass.

5333.about: A young man with a backpack films himself from below as he climbs one staircase after another inside four different buildings: first a plain grey concrete stairwell, then a white spiral staircase, then a wooden staircase under a crystal chandelier, and finally a huge marble staircase covered in red carpet in a grand opera-house foyer. His eyes widen and his mouth opens further at every new staircase.
5333.question: What is the young man doing?

5334.about: In a packed floodlit stadium at night a big bearded man in a denim jacket gets to his feet and lays his hand flat on his chest. Around him the whole block of spectators does the same - older men in team hoodies, a woman in a black coat - all standing still and looking towards the pitch while flags are held up behind them. The camera then pulls back to show the entire stadium on its feet.

phrases.target: the man in the denim jacket

phrases.en: to have a bushy white beard
phrases.target: the man in the denim jacket

5334.question: What is the man in denim carrying?

5335.about: A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans springs up out of her seat in a packed football stadium, her face lit up, and cheers. She throws both arms above her head and claps hard while the fans around her get to their feet as well. The shot then widens: first the whole stand is up, then the full stadium under the floodlights at dusk.

phrases.en: to leap out of her seat
phrases.target: the woman in the denim jacket

phrases.en: to applaud with her arms raised
phrases.target: the woman in the denim jacket

5335.question: What is the woman in denim doing?
5335.answer: She is applauding with her arms raised.

5336.about: In a floodlit stadium at night a grey-bearded man in a flat cap and black denim jacket takes off his cap, holds it against his chest and lays his hand over it. He looks up towards the stands and sings along with the anthem while the men and women around him stand with their hands on their hearts. The camera drifts back to show a long row of supporters all doing exactly the same.
5336.question: What is the grey-bearded man doing?
5336.answer: He is clutching his cap to his chest.

5337.about: A young man films himself with an outstretched arm on a small country railway platform while an orange and grey train pulls in behind him on the rails; he is holding a croissant. The shot cuts to him walking through a busy indoor railway station under big departure boards, commuters and rolling suitcases around him and the croissant in his mouth. He ends alone on a wide platform under a huge arched glass roof, tracks running away on both sides, looking up into the light.

phrases.en: to gaze up at the roof

5337.question: What is the young man looking at?
5337.answer: He is gazing up at the glass roof.

5338.about: A price caption rises with every scene. At 10 euros a backpacker climbs barefoot onto a metal bunk in a crowded hostel dormitory. At 100 euros a woman in a suit opens the door of a bright hotel room with a city view and walks in past the big white bed. At 10,000 euros an older couple step out through glass doors onto the deck of an overwater villa with a glass floor over turquoise water, then sit together on the bed above the sea, laughing.

phrases.en: to climb onto a bunk bed

5338.question: What is the young man doing?
5338.answer: He is climbing onto a bunk bed.

5339.about: A woman in a denim shirt sits in the driver's seat of a small parked car with her seat belt on, both hands on the steering wheel, turning it one way and then the other and watching where the car points. The shot cuts to the same woman in the driver's cab of a city bus, taking hold of a huge flat steering wheel with both hands and turning it, grinning at how big it is, with buses and the depot visible through the windscreen.

phrases.en: to grin at the huge wheel

5339.question: What is the woman doing?
5339.answer: She is gripping a huge steering wheel.

5340.about: Two boys carry a big cardboard box together into an open garage, the up-and-over door raised and the lawn and fence bright outside. They set it down among other flat-pack boxes, open one and find a football, which the smaller boy lifts out and throws. A close shot shows one boy tightening the bolts of a pale wooden bunk-bed frame. Indoors the finished bunk bed stands made up; the two boys bump fists and then sit side by side on the bottom bunk, laughing at the camera.
5340.question: What are the boys carrying?
5340.answer: They are carrying a big box.

5342.about: In a bright kitchen a woman helps a girl hold a piping bag and pipe pink swirls onto a tray of cupcakes. The woman then dabs a fingerful of frosting onto the girl's outstretched tongue and both of them laugh. Later the woman braids the girl's hair while a man watches from the background; the girl holds up a crayon drawing of three figures under a red heart and shows it to her, they talk, and the two end in a long hug.

phrases.en: to hold up a crayon drawing

5342.question: What is the girl tasting?
5342.answer: She is tasting the pink frosting.

5343.about: Two girls play in a bedroom that holds two identical white beds side by side, matching headboards and matching bare mattresses. They flop back onto one bed each, laughing at the camera. Sitting cross-legged on the beds they thread coloured beads into bracelets from a tray and fasten one onto the other girl's wrist. Then they pull jackets on in front of a tall mirror and dance together on the carpet.

phrases.en: to put on a navy jacket

5343.question: What are the girls sitting on?
5343.answer: They are sitting on twin beds.

5344.about: Close-ups of hand sewing: a needle and white thread pull a button tight on a checked shirt, a needle closes a rip in blue jeans, and a colourful flower is embroidered on white linen; a pocket knife points at a denim jacket button. Then a bright room of young women sitting on the floor with fabric squares, who lift a big finished patchwork quilt of many coloured pieces and cheer behind it.
5344.question: What are the women showing?
5344.answer: They are showing a patchwork quilt.

5345.about: A blonde woman in an orange running top jogs along a riverside bridge beside a running partner. Her face twists, she grabs her side and slows to a halt, then lays her forearm on the white bridge railing and rests her weight against it, bent forward and screwing up her face while her partner stops next to her.
5345.question: What is the woman doing?
5345.answer: She is leaning on the railing.

5346.about: A curly-haired young man stands in a school canteen queue with both hands flat on his middle, wincing and talking as the line shuffles past trays of food. He then sits at a table and forks up a huge mouthful of spaghetti in tomato sauce, chews with his eyes shut, and finally leans back and pats his middle with both hands, satisfied.
5346.question: What is the young man eating?
5346.answer: He is eating a bowl of spaghetti.

5347.about: A traffic policeman in a khaki uniform and peaked cap stands on the centre line of a busy Indian street. He raises a white-gloved palm towards the oncoming traffic and the scooters, motorbikes and cars slow and come to a halt in front of him. A city bus rolls up and stops right behind him, and he then stretches both arms out sideways to hold the two lanes still.
5347.question: What is the policeman doing?

5348.about: On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.
5348.question: What is the older man holding?
5348.answer: He is holding a black umbrella.
